assumptions.player_orders: Own-turn whenever affordable and room; no off-turn ordering or queue races modeled.
assumptions.boss: Stages 4/5 commit attack-plus-bill combos; stage 5 conserves meaningful defense and reads public player reward abilities.
assumptions.player: Same public-state utility, passive-aware rewards, stage-independent temperature .065; not optimal human play.
assumptions.ability_choices: Uniform among three uniformly sampled unowned abilities unless economy mode.
assumptions.timing: Authored choreography plus modeled human delays; excludes frame overhead, pauses, menus/reading outside decisions and clicking next stage.
assumptions.coupon: Acquisition and stage-start coupon grants wait for free slots outside busy presentation.
assumptions.pressure_attacks: Target next-shake pressure; pending through passes/replacement bottles until target shakes; reset at stage transition.
assumptions.stockpile: Player holds 12 tokens after ordering while HP>2; otherwise same short-horizon policy. This is one simple reserve policy, not optimal saving.
assumptions.ability_rework: Middle safe +1; HP<=2 risk -5pp; 12 tokens at commitment safe +1. No item ownership requirement.
